title: APPROVE Motion by Padilla, Bass, and Sandoval to direct the Chief Executive Officer to: A. Prepare a First/Last Mile plan for the Sun Valley Metrolink…
summary: Metro would have staff prepare a first/last mile plan for the Sun Valley Metrolink Station, evaluate more parking near the Pacoima station, and confirm that Sylmar station planning still applies, reporting back in 60 to 180 days.

locations.text: Pacoima Metrolink Station and Mobility Hub
